title: 副词的位置

examples.en: He is always late for school.

guess.question: “他总是迟到”，always 该放在哪里？

options.text: 放在 be 后面：He is always late.
options.feedback: 对！频度副词跟着 be 走，放在 be 后面。

options.text: 放在 be 前面：He always is late.
options.feedback: 不对——be 动词是个例外，频度副词要放在它后面。
不对——位置有规矩：be 之后、实义动词之前。

rule.rule: 频度副词（always / usually / often / sometimes / seldom / hardly / never）放在 be 动词、助动词、情态动词之后，实义动词之前；sometimes 也可以放在句首或句末
rule.formula: ① be / 情态动词 / 助动词 + 频度副词：He is always late. / I can never forget it.　② 频度副词 + 实义动词：He often goes there.　③ sometimes 可放句首句末

anchors.en: She is never late for class.
He often goes to school by bike.

trap.wrong: He always is late for school.
trap.right: He is always late for school.
trap.why: 有 be 动词时，频度副词放在 be 后面。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住一句话：be 后、实义动词前。

check.stem: My father ____ goes to work by bus.

options.distractor: goes 是实义动词，前面不加 be
一般现在时不需要助动词 does

check.explanation: 频度副词放实义动词前：always goes。

check.stem: She ____ late for school. She is a good student.

options.distractor: 有 be 动词时，频度副词放 be 后面
late 是形容词，前面要用 be

check.stem: — Do you often go to the cinema? — No, I ____ go there. Maybe once a year.
